messages:
emily: I published the postmortem for last night's connection spike — https://redwood.internal/pm/2412345678 :link: TL;DR: misrouted fallback + config drift in the routing tier. RCA + timeline in the doc. Please review and ack by EOD.

santiago: Thanks emily. Quick q — do we have a short rollback play if a similar spike hits during peak?

emily: Good call. There's a hotfix rollback listed under Action 2 (leo). It's a short-circuit routing toggle we can trigger. See the 'Operational runbook' section.

ops-bot: INCIDENT SUMMARY: peak error rate 14:02-14:17 UTC, p95 latency up 4x, auto-fallback failed on 3 of 5 clusters. Attachments: logs + traced requests.

leo: I will own Action 1 (routing config validation) and Action 2 (rollback toggle test). Targeting FYI: test in staging by WED 12:00 UTC, deploy to prod Fri 03:00 UTC if green.

jane: I'll take Action 3 (canary + alerting update). Will add the new alert thresholds and run canary for two cycles.

devin: I'll follow up on dashboards — adding a split by route and a synthetic every-5m probe. ETA Thu EOD.

emily: Action items (summary):
- Action 1: routing config validation — owner: leo — due: 2026-03-26T12:00Z
- Action 2: rollback toggle test + runbook steps — owner: leo — due: 2026-03-27T03:00Z
- Action 3: canary + alert threshold changes — owner: jane — due: 2026-03-26T18:00Z
- Action 4: dashboard + synthetic probes — owner: devin — due: 2026-03-26T23:59Z
- Action 5: post-deploy verification checklist update (docs) — owner: emily — due: 2026-03-29T17:00Z

pm-bot: Calendar: created follow-up checkpoint 'Postmortem check-in' Thu 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC — invite sent to @platform-team, @eng-oncall.

santiago: Acked and added to my calendar. I'll join the checkpoint and help run the rollback drill if needed. :white_check_mark:

emily: Thanks all — please update the doc with short check-ins on your action items (one-line) before the Thu checkpoint. If anything slips, ping me directly.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: check-in reminder will post 1h before the meeting.

leo: Noted. Will post staging test results as a comment in the PM doc.

emily: Closing the thread for now — feel free to DM for anything urgent. Appreciate the quick turn here. :heart:
